pictures.author: Gryffindor
pictures.observed: Pale stone/plastered hall; three pointed front bays/central brown entry and four tall garden windows; paneled upper frieze, shallow lead cushion roof, short stone minaret with pierced balcony guard/blunt rounded cap/finial. Independent large stone palace wall behind.

pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Interior reference: pointed window silhouettes with thin dark-brown vertical/horizontal mullions and tall lower panes. Plain recess between rear windows. Furnishings/chandelier/calligraphy/painted artwork are not reproduced.

pictures.author: Marku1988, based on Gryffindor photographs
pictures.observed: Stitched exterior panorama: full small hall proportions, four tall garden windows and three entry bays, shallow lead cushion roof, short round minaret with open pierced guard, moulded support/rounded stub cap and finial. Low base plinth and near-ground entry; stitching may distort proportions.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Sofa Mosque: small pale rectangular prayer hall with four tall pointed windows along its garden side, three front bays and a real central entry, fine brown window mullions, shallow lead cushion roof, paneled upper frieze/cornice and a short attached cylindrical stone minaret with moulded balcony support, a genuinely pierced lozenge guard, blunt rounded cap and finial. Plain interior; no copied inscriptions/art, chandelier, furnishings or independent neighbouring palace range.
